label: Modal spine A2: inert emptiness from three grounding principles, objection and warrant audit
summary: Target: premise A2 of Arrival A in the modal spine (inert emptiness, 395cb0f6, InertEmptiness.EmptinessStaysEmpty), consumed by InertEmptiness.necessaryConcrete toward STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-AT and STMT-GOD-EXISTS. Spec specs/modal-spine-grounded-beginnings.toml, module TruthCore/Causality/GroundedBeginnings.lean. DERIVATION. Three OPEN analyst principles over a supplied world-relative grounding relation (same shape as BruteFoundationBoundary.Profile.grounds): G1 grounded beginnings (c7580712): a concrete thing absent at a moment and present at a strictly later one has a concrete ground; G2 grounds not ceased before the absence (e61dbc22): each such ground is present at the moment of absence or at some later moment (weaker than temporal locality; a simultaneous or later ground is allowed); G3 well-founded grounding among concrete things present at some moment of each history (81c39a34). (1) nothingFromNothing (result 0f93dc77): G1, G2, G3 give the traced form of 'from nothing, nothing comes' (e6a1ac3c): whatever concrete thing is present at t traces back, by a finite chain of grounding links of length zero or more, to a concrete thing present at any earlier moment. Well-founded induction on grounds, non-transcription. (2) inertOfNothingFromNothing (c758bec1): the traced form gives A2; registered strengthens relation (traced form to A2), strict by control 5. (3) inertOfGroundedBeginnings (76e82b07): the composition G1, G2, G3 to A2, the support route the frontier counts (a strength registration is not a route). (4) controls (d3d432c9): each of G1, G2, G3 is needed for A2 where the other two hold (a ground-free beginning out of nothing; a ground present only at time 0 of a thing present only at time 2 with time 1 empty; BegunComingToBe.Control.zeno, an endless chain of present concrete grounds descending towards an empty first moment of WithBot Int time); G1 to G3 and the traced form hold in InertEmptiness.Control.initialState with no grounds and no necessary individual at either world; G1 to G3 hold with presence-to-existence and the possible contingent-free past in InertEmptiness.Control.rooted, where Arrival A's conclusion holds. CIRCULARITY CHECK. The bundle does not re-import the conclusion or its possibility: unlike the founded-past grounding bundle (ComingToBeHorns.possiblyNecessaryOfEarlierGrounds), it holds in a model with no necessary concrete individual at any world (control 4). In Arrival A necessity still comes from A3 with presence-to-existence and the frame premises. Inside one history the bundle does entail that any concrete thing present after any moment s traces to something concrete present at s; it entails nothing modal. OBJECTION AUDIT (Substantive Objection Standard). (a) The recorded rival, a beginning out of nothing (84526937), is model-witnessed only (InertEmptiness.Control.exNihilo); no independent justification for its mechanism is on file, so it is not a substantive objection; the model shows A2 is needed, not that it is doubtful. (b) Quantum-cosmological 'creation from nothing'. Hartle and Hawking (claim e6300451, read, pp. 2960-2961): a ground-state wave function from a sum over compact Euclidean four-geometries. As recorded, nothing in it is a time-ordered pair of a moment with no concrete thing present and a later populated moment; the proposal supplies a quantum state and an action, and its Euclidean regime has no Lorentzian time in which a zero three-geometry would precede the universe. So it does not instantiate A2's rival; it bears on the initial-state question (A3), not on A2. Vilenkin 1982, 'Creation of universes from nothing' (UNREAD lead, from memory; read before citing): tunnelling from a state with no classical spacetime, computed under quantum-gravitational laws. It would bear on A2 only if (i) its 'nothing' were a moment of the same time order preceding the universe and (ii) the laws and quantum state present there were not concrete; then it would also be a ground-free beginning against G1 if laws are non-concrete grounds. Neither (i) nor (ii) has independent justification on file, and on the recalled description the 'nothing' has no time; no weight is given. Quantum-vacuum 'nothing' (UNREAD lead): a field state is concrete on any ordinary reading, so the moment is not concrete-empty and A2 is untouched. (c) Standard FLRW cosmology: the initial singularity is not a point of the spacetime manifold, so there is no empty moment and A2 is silent. Adjoining t = 0 as an empty moment would turn a populated FLRW history into an instance of A2's rival and of the zeno shape (G1 and G2 hold, G3 fails); no independent justification for adjoining it is on file. RESULT: no rebutting objection (evidence that A2, G1, G2 or G3 is false) is identified, and no objection of any kind to G2 or G3. One undercutting objection, to an inductive warrant for G1 and A2, applies by parity from a rival on file: the contingent-natural restriction rival recorded for B2 (attempt 169b007b, docs/notes/causal-temporal-rival-coverage.md): the inductive base of ordinary caused beginnings always contains an available bearer, so it supports 'beginnings within a populated history have grounds' as well as G1, and the restricted principle is silent exactly when the earlier moment is empty, which is where A2 is needed (it is contraposed at a contingent-free moment in Arrival A). This undercuts an inductive warrant for G1 and A2; it is not evidence of any ungrounded beginning or of an empty moment followed by a populated one, and a non-inductive (a priori) ex nihilo warrant would not face it. WARRANT AUDIT. Before this attempt no independent warrant for A2 was on file (its definition records the bridge from ordinary experience as open). Now A2 has a derivation from three OPEN premises; none is sourced and none is established. G1 is a restricted causal principle for beginnings (any concrete ground, not a sufficient or deterministic cause); G2 is a no-gap condition on grounds weaker than temporal locality; G3 is well-founded grounding restricted to present concreta, the premise that excludes the strongest formal rival compatible with G1 and G2 (an endless chain of present grounds after an empty moment, descending in time towards it as in zeno, or all present at one later moment). The derivation relocates A2's warrant into these principles; it does not show that they are better warranted than A2. The crux of Arrival A remains the universal scope of A2 (equivalently of G1 with G2 and G3) over every possible history, including one with an empty moment. No premise is established.
blocker: Not blocked. G1, G2 and G3 are OPEN with no source or independent warrant on file; the standing rival of G1 and A2 is the contingent-natural restriction rival, an undercutting objection to inductive warrant. Next tests: state and test a non-inductive ex nihilo warrant for G1 (read a classical source such as Aquinas's or Parmenides's ex nihilo principle into a pinned claim only if selected); read Vilenkin 1982 if the quantum-cosmological lead is selected, and check (i) whether its 'nothing' is a moment of the time order and (ii) whether its laws and state count as concrete; test whether G3 can be replaced by a weaker condition on time (founded intervals above the empty moment) and compare their prices; and a metric counterpart of A2 needing no empty moment (Next investigations item 1).
